newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Technically firm but cash beef and live markets trending lower.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Index down slightly and corn futures called higher.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.150 to off 0.150 cent. Carryover technical support and steady cash hog indications but drop in cutout values may press market.
PORK BELLIES - Steady to up 0.500 cent. Technically very strong and carryover from bullish Cold storage report.
